title: Bring a file home
story: Your ColabFold model {{file}} is on Geiss-01 in ~/{{project}}/results. Copy it to the Downloads folder on your laptop. scp always runs on your laptop, so use the Laptop tab above the terminal.

tasks.text: Copy {{file}} into Downloads on your laptop

hints: In the Laptop tab, `scp SERVER:PATH DESTINATION` copies from the server. The server part is `student@geiss-01:`.
Switch to the Laptop tab and run `scp student@geiss-01:~/{{project}}/results/{{file}} ~/Downloads/`, then `ls ~/Downloads`.
